availability: Prospective observations only: issuer as-of dates do not establish historical availability. Use the actual first capture strictly before a decision.
limitations: Issuer statistics are current-vintage aggregates, not reconstructed constituent financial statements or historical analyst forecasts.
Holdings weights include cash and derivative valuation weights; these are not derivative notional exposures. Missing constituent sectors remain missing.
Shares outstanding are rounded. Changes are not certified fund flows; split-aware share history and distributions are still required.
Issuer identity is verified separately from audited adjusted/raw price coverage and IB contract/account eligibility. These snapshots do not admit funds to a strategy.
rights: Public issuer evidence retained for internal research inspection only. No redistribution entitlement or licensed historical holdings/estimates feed is assumed.
